issues.description: sys is referenced in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without a visible import sys
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards in both impl files but no corresponding `import sys` is shown. If sys isn't already imported at module top, these modules NameError at import time on every Python version. Verify and add the import where missing.

issues.description: Version-gated registration of Math_unary is mis-shaped: rebinds the class name and lacks structural separation
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block sits glued to the class with no blank line and rebinds Math_unary to the decorator's return. Subsequent references then point at the wrong object. Use a bare `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` statement placed clearly after the class with proper spacing.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idiom: sys.version_info in source, PYVERSION in tests
issues.detail: The codebase already exposes numba.core.utils.PYVERSION, which the test uses. Production modules use raw sys.version_info, creating two sources of truth for the same predicate across three files. Unify on PYVERSION so a future Python-version bump is audited in one notation.

issues.description: Test inputs cloned from test_exp; no edge cases or exp2-specific semantics exercised
issues.detail: x_values reuses exp's list verbatim (with a duplicate -2/2) and probes none of the values where exp2 is interesting: integer powers (exact results), zero, near-overflow ~1024, denormals, inf/nan, or large negative. Add targeted inputs and ideally a parity check against CPython math.exp2.

issues.description: Release note RST file missing trailing newline and underline length is fragile
issues.detail: docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst ends without a newline and the underline does not match the title length, which some RST toolchains warn or error on. Trivial fix: add the newline and match underline length to the title.

issues.description: Single fact (math.exp2 exists from 3.11) duplicated as imperative branches across three modules
issues.detail: The version-availability rule is encoded as three separate if-branches rather than as data in one place. A small registry mapping (name, intrinsic, min_version) keyed by PYVERSION would decompose this and make future additions a data change rather than three coordinated edits.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a NEEDS-WORK verdict. Two P0 defects sink the patch as submitted: sys is referenced in both impl files without a visible import, and the version-gated registration in mathdecl.py rebinds Math_unary as a side effect rather than invoking the decorator as a bare statement. Beyond that, the diff invents three different ways to spell "Python >= 3.11" when PYVERSION already exists, and the test was cloned from test_exp without probing exp2-specific behavior (integer powers, overflow, zero, inf/nan). The release note has a trailing-newline and underline-length nit. Shape of the feature is right; execution needs another pass.
